integrity: Exact proof plus independently implemented finite carry-state and dyadic-count checks; no external expert validation.
scientific_limitations: Only carry counts between zero and the binary weight are classified.
The gap condition is sufficient; smaller gaps are not generally classified.
The general all-shift recurrences in earlier literature imply computability but do not explicitly supply the claimed uniform family formula in inspected material.
Originality against inaccessible complete recent preprints remains at some risk.
title: Exact low-carry laws for separated binary shifts
